comparison.objective: Unzip an antistatic bag, extract one 18650 cell, orient it in a holder, leave the other cell, and return the arms; the candidate adjusts and validates a gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-1302 tests zipper operation, selective extraction, cylindrical insertion, and polarity orientation; the candidate tests coaxial driver/wrench manipulation and locknut counterholding.
comparison.success_condition: PR-1302 grades unzip travel, extraction, seated upright polarity, the remaining cell, arm return, and one-second stillness; the candidate grades retained opening angle and repeated cycles.
comparison.reason: Only the complete PR body was available—no task.json/spec, exact setup dimensions, or fidelity rubric—but its stated objective and numeric scoring are clearly unrelated to threaded stop locking.
